summary: Let viewers identify and inspect a part without confusing it with a disposable mesh or decoration.
objective: Let viewers identify and inspect a part without confusing it with a disposable mesh or decoration.
example_prompts: Use inspectable selection and part identity for the scene, preserving its model and user controls.

principles: Select the semantic object the user cares about, which may contain many render meshes.
Selection feedback should remain distinguishable from scientific color encoding or material changes.
implementation: Map hit-test results to stable part IDs and clear names.
Offer a visible equivalent control for essential selection tasks when spatial picking is difficult.
Keep selected metadata synchronized through hide/reveal, camera changes and reset.
observable_checks: Selecting a child mesh identifies its intended assembly or part.
An unavailable or hidden part is handled explicitly without retaining misleading stale information.

creative_affordances: Adapt the layout, visual treatment and timing to the task; these are reusable design proposals, not mandatory templates.
known_limits: Authored interaction/presentation guidance; no new scientific claim, accessibility certification or runtime verification is asserted.
